You are a repository-rooted sub-session, opened per the BLOCKING GATE in Section 4.A.2 of this repository's AGENTS.md. Your working root is the checkout you were launched in. Follow AGENTS.md there. This task is narrow: apply exactly the corrections listed under ITEMS, commit, and stop.

CONTEXT. The branch checked out here holds this repository's final pull request for the Actions-lockfile task (LCV-719 and LCV-738), not yet pushed. An adversarial review and a mechanical sweep found the defects listed below. Most are the same kind: a version written in prose must equal the version the workflow actually pins. The live Linear Release pin, in every repository below, is:

  uses: linear/linear-release-action@cfd42077dccdc0c26a38589934e2aa11046f57b7 # v0.18.3

RULES. Change only what ITEMS names, line by line. Never switch branches, rebase, amend, reset, stash or rewrite existing commits. Never pass --no-verify. Never run `entire session attach`. Never push. Keep each file's line endings and encoding exactly as they are: edit bytes, not re-serialized text (PowerShell's Set-Content or Out-File can add a BOM or change CRLF to LF; prefer a small python script that reads the file as bytes, replaces the exact byte sequence, and writes bytes back). After editing, `git diff --stat` must show only the files of ITEMS, a few lines each: a whole-file change means the line endings changed, so undo that file (`git checkout -- <file>`) and redo the edit on bytes.

ITEMS
- LF. `.github/workflows/verify-lockfile.yml` was committed with CRLF line endings; this repository stores LF. Rewrite it from the committed bytes, replacing every `\r\n` with `\n` and changing nothing else:
    python -c "import subprocess;p='.github/workflows/verify-lockfile.yml';b=subprocess.run(['git','cat-file','blob','HEAD:'+p],capture_output=True).stdout;open(p,'wb').write(b.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n'))"
  Proof: the committed blob of the new HEAD has 0 carriage returns and the same number of line feeds as before; `git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol HEAD~1 HEAD -- .github/workflows/verify-lockfile.yml` is empty.

FINAL PROOF. Set TMP, TEMP and TMPDIR to a temp/ folder inside this checkout first. Paste each output:
  git status --porcelain                       -> only the files of ITEMS
  git diff --stat                              -> only those files, a few lines each
  git diff --check                             -> empty
  python "C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\temp\sync-master-text.py" --check "C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\lcv-leo"   -> both files already in sync. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are never items: if either appears changed, STOP and report.
  & "C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\temp\sweep-versions.ps1" -Root "C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\lcv-leo"         -> VERSION-SWEEP CLEAN
  & "C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\temp\check-inventory.ps1" -Root "C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\lcv-leo"        -> no MISSING-FROM-INVENTORY line
  & "C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\temp\verify-claims.ps1" -Root "C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\lcv-leo"          -> CLEAN, except for the single informational line `WORKFLOW-CHANGED .github/workflows/linear-release.yml` when ITEMS edits the comment of that file; any other line is a defect: fix it.
  & "C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\temp\check-urls.ps1" -Root "C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\lcv-leo"             -> every URL answers 200
  gh actions-lock --verify                                                                    -> all workflows valid
  For each existing workflow file ITEMS edited: its blob keeps its line endings (the carriage-return count of `git cat-file blob HEAD:<file>` equals the one of `HEAD~1:<file>`; count bytes with python `subprocess`, not with a PowerShell text pipe), and after the commit `git diff HEAD~1 HEAD -- <file>` shows only comment lines, each starting with whitespace and `#`.

COMMITS. Message in temp/commit-msg.txt (US English, Conventional Commits, the trailer `Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>` as the last line). `git add` each file by name (never temp/). `git commit -S -F temp/commit-msg.txt`. Never --no-verify.
  1. If ITEMS contains the item `LF`, commit that file alone first, with exactly this message:

ci(lockfile): store the verify-lockfile workflow with LF line endings

The file was committed with CRLF line endings while every other file in this
repository is stored with LF. Its content does not change.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

  2. If other items remain, commit them together with this message (title given under ITEMS; the body has one line per correction, then `Refs: LCV-719`, then the trailer):

(none)

  For every commit, verify the `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer in `git log -1 --format=%B` and its ref under refs/entire/checkpoints/.

STOP. No push, no pull request.
REPORT (short): each item with the text before and after; the FINAL PROOF outputs; each new commit sha with its checkpoint id.
